title: Skin Care for Indore Weather: A Routine for Dry Summers, Monsoon and Cold Winter Nights
ex: Hot dry summers, a humid monsoon and a cool, dry winter on the Malwa plateau: a simple skin care routine for people living in Indore.
rt: Skin Care for Indore Weather: Seasonal Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Indore weather: sun and dust care for dry summers, light layers in monsoon, moisture for cold winter nights, hard water and two-wheeler tips.
quick: Indore has a hot, dry summer, a humid monsoon and a cool, dry winter with cold nights. A gentle face wash, a moisturiser, broad-spectrum sunscreen every morning and a night cream kept light in the monsoon and used more from November to February suit most skin.
facts: Indore is on the Malwa plateau in central India
April and May are very hot and mostly dry
The monsoon runs from late June to September
December and January bring cold mornings and dry air
